name: GLM 5.3
description: GLM 5.3 is Z.AI's frontier coding and agentic model, with low, high, and max reasoning effort levels and a 1M-token context window on the GLM Coding Plan.

details.name: availability
details.value: Available as glm-5.3 through Z.AI's Model API and to GLM Coding Plan users.

details.name: context_length
details.value: 1,000,000 tokens on Coding Plan endpoints; use the glm-5.3[1m] model suffix in supported coding agents.

details.name: reasoning_effort
details.value: Always reasons. Supports low, high, and max efforts, with max as the default. minimal/light/low map to low; medium/high map to high; xhigh/max/ultra map to max. Disabling thinking maps to low rather than turning reasoning off.

details.name: weights
details.value: Public model weights are available as of 2026-08-26.
